title: Cystatin C
what: This blood test checks a protein that shows how well your kidneys clean your blood.
why: When kidney function needs a more precise check, especially if creatinine may be misleading: in older people, in people with a lot of muscle or very little, and before choosing medicine doses.
duration: the blood draw usually takes 5 minutes; results usually come in 1 to 3 days
tell_doctor: If you have a thyroid condition
Kidney disease, diabetes, or high blood pressure

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: You usually do not need to fast, but it is often done with other blood chemistry tests that need fasting. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Tell your doctor what you take.

steps: You sit down, and a band is tied above your elbow
The skin is wiped with antiseptic
Blood is taken from a vein into a tube
The band is removed, and a cotton pad is pressed on the spot
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
Sometimes slight dizziness. Tell the nurse, and they will help you lie down
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Results usually come in 1 to 3 days
The doctor will use it to work out your kidney function and adjust medicine doses if needed

faq.q: Why cystatin C if I already have creatinine?
faq.a: Creatinine depends on your muscles and diet. Cystatin C depends on them less, so together they give a more accurate picture.
Cystatin C itself barely depends on food. But if you also have chemistry tests, fasting is better. Check with the lab.

reminders.text: Cystatin C test tomorrow. If it is with other blood chemistry tests, do not eat after dinner. Water is fine.
